turns.user: I just arrived from Korea and I do not have a Social Security Number. Can I open an account?
turns.assistant: Yes, you can. You do not need a Social Security Number, and here are the documents you will need.

turns.user: Can I use Zelle to pay my roommate?
turns.assistant: Zelle enrollment requires a Social Security Number. That comes from UFCU branch staff; the website does not say it. Here is what to use instead.

turns.user: Great. I want to open the account.
turns.assistant: Bring your passport and I-20. I will prefill the rest of the application for you.

turns.note: Card reasons, in order: savings, free-checking, simply-u
reasons: The account that creates your membership. It opens with $1, and every other account attaches to it.
No monthly fee, no minimum balance, and a debit card issued on the spot.
No overdraft fees at all, which makes it a safe first account in the US.

turns.user: I'm starting a food truck LLC and I need a business account.
turns.assistant: Membership starts with a personal savings account, and the business account attaches to it. Two steps, same day.

turns.user: What documents do I need for the LLC?
turns.assistant: For a Texas LLC it is four things, plus an ID for every person who signs.
I am leaving the application ready with the personal membership first; the business documents come in the next step.

turns.note: Card reasons, in order: savings, business-checking
reasons: Opens your membership with $1 and is the account the business account attaches to.
For your LLC: a business debit card and digital banking, with no monthly fee on the basic tier.
